🎬 Like Mike (2002)

Like Mike follows Calvin Cambridge, a fourteen-year-old orphan who dreams of becoming a professional basketball player despite his small size. His life changes unexpectedly when he discovers a mysterious pair of sneakers believed to have belonged to Michael Jordan. After the shoes are struck by lightning, Calvin gains extraordinary basketball abilities, allowing him to compete alongside professional NBA players. He earns a spot on the fictional Los Angeles Knights and develops an unlikely friendship with veteran player Tracy Reynolds, who becomes an important mentor in his life. While experiencing fame and success, Calvin continues searching for something more meaningful—a loving family. Starring Bow Wow, Morris Chestnut, and Jonathan Lipnicki, the film combines entertaining basketball action, comedy, and heartfelt storytelling while exploring friendship, perseverance, family, and the importance of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Fantasy • Sports

⭐ IMDb: 5.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG

🎥 Director: John Schultz
